Introduction

RIIZE, is a six-member South Korean boy group under SM Entertainment. They made their debut with the release of "Get a Guitar" on September 4, 2023.

Members Eunseok and Seunghan were originally revealed through SM Entertainment's SMROOKIES trainee team on July 2, 2022. Later in October of the same year, SMROOKIES official account posted images showing the silhouettes of seven boys who were speculated to be the members of their next boy group. On May 24, 2023, SM Entertainment's CEO announced that Eunseok and Seunghan would debut in their next boy group, along with Sungchan and Shotaro, announcing their official departure as members of NCT.

It was reported on July 12, that the group would debut in September and were currently filming their music video as well as making final preparations. Days later, on July 18, it was reported that Lee Chanyoung, son of composer and singer Yoon Sang, would be one of the members.

The group generated a lot of buzz and anticipation among fans pre-debut, with their official Instagram account launching on August 1, 2023, and revealing the members for the first time. On August 7, RIIZE further showcased their talents by releasing a captivating performance video of their song “Siren”.

On November 21, 2023, SM Entertainment announced that Seunghan was put on an indefinite hiatus after a series of information about his private life was leaked through online channels. On October 10, 2024, it was announced that Seunghan would come back to the group in November, almost a year after being put on hiatus. However, on October 13, SM Entertainment quickly retracted their statement about Seunghan's return to Riize and he had instead left the group.
